description: This file defines the NotesController class which manages the save and edit view actions for notes in the SuiteCRM system. It handles file uploads, associates notes with contacts, manages notification logic, and allows deletion of attachments.

classes.name: NotesController
classes.description: Controller class for managing note-related actions such as saving notes and editing notes view within SuiteCRM.

methods.name: action_save
methods.description: Handles saving a note, including processing file uploads, setting contact associations, and managing notifications.

methods.name: action_editview
methods.description: Prepares the edit view for a note and handles deletion of attachments if requested.
